answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch, fixed slots go to top bidders. An honest agent bids once: 12 POA for a slot earning 60 POA over a 30-epoch horizon. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must outbid honest agents 1,000 times; each bid lifts the price, so at 20 POA a slot the attack costs 20,000 POA for nothing. No fable: the arithmetic is real, one slot, one price, no bulk discount, so no comet of fakes dilutes honest rewards.
